newsitem.title: USA: Delta unit expands ties with Circle Int'l.
newsitem.headline: Delta unit expands ties with Circle Int'l.

text.p: Delta Air Cargo, the cargo unit of Delta Air Lines, said Monday it expanded its relationship with Circle International Inc, a privately-held, San Francisco-based logistics provider.

Under the expanded agreement, Circle representatives will consolidate shipments on the spot at selected Delta cargo facilities, eliminating the need to move shipments back and forth between Delta and Circle facilities, said Delta Air Cargo chief Buddy Doll.

Previously, international shipments would be transported to a Delta cargo gateway, received and consolidated by Circle personnel at their facilities and returned to Delta as an export shipment, Doll said.
Along with the streamling, Circle has linked its Fastrack airfreight system with the Delta unit's Cargofax system to allow instant tracking of shipments globally, Delta said.
